$about: The authoritative register of interaction states — the situations every surface must handle
(#616, ratified thirteen on #495, 2026-08-04). This is a DIFFERENT population from
tokens.json /status: that file is the room-lifecycle vocabulary, this one is screen
situations; they overlap at cancelled/failed only, by cross-reference. 0020's rules govern
consumption: rendering is a projection, absence is not a state, one object per entry point.
Every other statement of this list is generated from or checked against this file:
gen-states, checked by audit-completeness). Editing those directly is reverted by the next
regeneration. 0020's prose copy of this list is retired — it drifted (stuck at ten while
the corpus reached thirteen), which is the failure this file exists to end.
coverage: either renderedBy (repo paths of the artifacts that carry the state today —
checked to exist) or pending (a pointer to the issue/record that will build it). A state
with neither fails Aer.Architecture.Tests: absence must be explicit, never silent.

empty.name: Empty
empty.behaviour: Says what would be here and offers the one action that creates it. Never a bare "no items".

loading.name: Loading
loading.behaviour: Keeps the previous content and marks it stale rather than blanking. A list that empties itself while refreshing reads as data loss.

disconnected.name: Disconnected
disconnected.behaviour: The phone says so at the top, keeps showing the last known rooms marked stale, and queues what you type. Work continues on the computer regardless — that is the point of the daemon owning the run.

coverage.pending: spec/journeys.md — phone disconnected state is Coverage.Pending

workerMissing.name: Worker missing
workerMissing.behaviour: A room whose vendor CLI is gone says which one and how to fix it. It is not a failure of the room.

folderGone.name: Folder gone
folderGone.behaviour: The room is greyed and marked unavailable, never an error dialog, and never silently dropped from the list.

cancelled.name: Cancelled
cancelled.behaviour: Reads as cancelled — a distinct state with its own mark, never collapsed into finished.
cancelled.provenance: Promoted from the #461 defect; second live copy fixed as #976

failed.name: Failed
failed.behaviour: Reads as failed, shows the error text in place, and offers the failing worker as the first way to fix it.

archived.name: Archived
archived.behaviour: Out of the default list, still searchable, restorable in one action.

longOutput.name: Long output
longOutput.behaviour: Truncated with an explicit "showing first N lines" and a way to see all of it. Never silently cut.

reducedMotion.name: Reduced motion
reducedMotion.behaviour: Every animated state degrades to a correct still frame — the working mark is a spinner's static frame by design, not an absence.

gateUnverified.name: Gate unverified
gateUnverified.behaviour: A worker whose permission mechanism could not be confirmed working at start says so before any tool runs, rather than silently rendering a gate that might never fire — a broken hook or a disabled callback both look exactly like a working one otherwise.

coverage.pending: 0029 — the verification exists at worker start; its surface state is unbuilt

waitingOnLock.name: Waiting on another room's lock
waitingOnLock.behaviour: Reads as a wait, never as an error and never as generic working: names the room that holds this folder, linked, so the choice — wait, or go there — is discoverable. Opening a second room on a folder that already has one warns first; legal, but a choice made knowingly.

coverage.pending: #752 — #618 shipped the wait banner with a real holder (probe + locked-mutation paths); the linked go-there navigation and the pre-open warn are what remain

dormant.name: Dormant
dormant.behaviour: The room stopped machine turns after repeated turns that committed nothing, and says so in the transcript with the reason and the wake control. A message to a dormant room is answered with this state — waking is your explicit action, never a side effect of asking how it's going.

coverage.pending: #778 turn host — engine half shipped (RoomTurnDecider); surface unbuilt

outOfPlan.name: Out of plan
outOfPlan.behaviour: Displays quota/subscription exhaustion with its reset time when known ("Out of plan — resumes {local time}") or an explicit unknown ("Out of plan — reset unknown"), distinct from failure.

unexpectedAppError.name: Unexpected app error
unexpectedAppError.behaviour: The app stays up and says what went wrong in the failure text already on screen — never a dialog, never a silent disappearance, and never a window that vanishes mid-task. The detail is kept on disk so the failure is still there to read afterwards.
